title: Cow reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox='0 0 100 100'>
  <!-- Cow Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='18' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- Cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='75' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Cow Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(-20 28 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(20 72 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0b0b0' transform='rotate(-20 28 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0b0b0' transform='rotate(20 72 34)'/>
  <!-- Cow spot on head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='36' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#f0b0b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#d08080'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#d08080'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d='M38 30 Q36 22 40 20' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 30 Q64 22 60 20' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='28' rx='2' fill='#e05050'/>
  <rect x='32' y='64' width='17' height='24' fill='#ffe8c0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='64' width='17' height='24' fill='#ffe8c0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='63' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#c03030' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Text lines on book -->
  <line x1='35' y1='69' x2='46' y2='69' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='73' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='77' x2='44' y2='77' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69' x2='65' y2='69' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='65' y2='73' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='62' y2='77' stroke='#c0a080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Hooves on book -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='60' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#e8d8a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#e8d8a0'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='59' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='96' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='96' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M80 72 Q88 68 86 78' stroke='#f5f0e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='78' r='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
</svg>
